envelope.description: Write the reclaim decision-table unit tests first (red)

body.title: Write the reclaim decision-table unit tests first (red)
body.summary: Test-first: extend src/shared/__tests__/daemon-run-files.test.ts with the decision-table cases - gone -> quarantine+acquire, previous-boot replaced -> quarantine+acquire, same/same-boot-replaced/corrupt-or-missing owner.json/throwing reader -> withhold with nothing renamed, retry EEXIST -> recompute and throw, symlink -> conflict, quarantine-name collision -> suffixed name, daemonLog line by nonce, log-write failure swallowed. Uses mkdtemp guard fixtures and a fake ProcessIdentityReader injected via the new optional third parameter.
acceptanceChecks: Suite fails red against the current fail-closed behavior for the reclaim cases
Withhold cases pass unchanged (same, same-boot replaced, corrupt owner.json, throwing reader)
Fake reader + mkdtemp fixtures in place, no real PID probing

tests.name: acquireRunFileGuard quarantines and acquires when the verdict is 'gone' (fake reader, mkdtemp guard)
acquireRunFileGuard quarantines and acquires on previous-boot 'replaced' (boot segments mismatch)
acquireRunFileGuard withholds 'same', same-boot 'replaced', corrupt or missing owner.json and a throwing reader; nothing is renamed
acquireRunFileGuard recomputes the conflict and throws when the retry mkdir hits EEXIST
acquireRunFileGuard leaves a symlink guard as a conflict
acquireRunFileGuard suffixes the quarantine name on collision; owner.json stays byte-identical and one daemonLog line is keyed by the recorded nonce; a log-write failure is swallowed
